toolTip.v: Create CNCJob with toolpaths for drilling or milling holes.

BASIC is suitable for a beginner. Many parameters
are hidden from the user in this mode.
ADVANCED mode will make available all parameters.

To change the application LEVEL, go to:
Edit -> Preferences -> General and check:
'APP. LEVEL' radio button.
Excellon object for drilling/milling operation.

This set the way that the tools in the tools table are used.
'No' --> means that the used order is the one in the tool table
'Forward' --> means that the tools will be ordered from small to big
'Reverse' --> means that the tools will ordered from big to small

WARNING: using rest machining will automatically set the order
in reverse and disable this control.

Will search and try to replace the tools from Tools Table
with tools from DB that have a close diameter value.

The data used for creating GCode.
Each tool store it's own set of such data.

Drill depth (negative)
below the copper surface.

Use multiple passes to limit
the cut depth in each pass. Will
cut multiple times until Cut Z is
reached.
Depth of each pass (positive).

Tool height when travelling
across the XY plane.

Tool speed while drilling
(in units per minute).
So called 'Plunge' feedrate.
This is for linear move G01.

Tool speed while drilling
(in units per minute).
This is for the rapid move G00.
It is useful only for Marlin,
ignore for any other cases.

Speed of the spindle
in RPM (optional)

Pause to allow the spindle to reach its
speed before cutting.
Number of time units for spindle to dwell.

Some drill bits (the larger ones) need to drill deeper
to create the desired exit hole diameter due of the tip shape.
The value here can compensate the Cut Z parameter.
If the selected tool has slots then they will be drilled.
How much (percentage) of the tool diameter to overlap previous drill hole.

If the slot length is not completely covered by drill holes,
add a drill hole on the slot end point.

The parameters in the current form will be applied
on all the tools from the Tool Table.
Parameters that are common for all tools.

Include tool-change sequence
in G-Code (Pause for tool change).

Z-axis position (height) for
tool change.

Height of the tool just after starting the work.
Delete the value if you don't need this feature.

Height of the tool after
the last move at the end of the job.

End move X,Y position. In format (x,y).
If no value is entered then there is no move
on X,Y plane at the end of the job.

The maximum depth that the probe is allowed
to probe. Negative value, in current units.
The feedrate used while the probe is probing.

The preprocessor JSON file that dictates
Gcode output for Excellon Objects.

Include exclusion areas.
In those areas the travel of the tools
is forbidden.

The strategy followed when encountering an exclusion area.
Can be:
- Over -> when encountering the area, the tool will go to a set height
- Around -> will avoid the exclusion area by going around the area

The height Z to which the tool will rise in order to avoid
an interdiction area.
Add an Exclusion Area.
The kind of selection shape used for area selection.
Delete all exclusion areas.
Delete all exclusion areas that are selected in the table.

Generate the CNC Job.
If milling then an additional Geometry object will be created.
Add / Select at least one tool in the tool-table.
Click the # header to select all, or Ctrl + LMB
for custom selection of tools.
Will reset the tool parameters.
